messages.subject: Uncertain convergence of an MCMC algorithm that is sensitive to the seed
parts:
Hi,

I am having an issue whereby it is uncertain if my chains converge - it varies from run to run (and obviously, the seed). In this circumstance, could I simply take the runs where it did converge  (and discard the rest), or could this be symptomatic of a deeper concern? (I am running 8-16 chains in each run).

Best,

Ben
